prompt_log.prompt: Tell me about Happi House
prompt_log.response:
## [Happi House Teriyaki](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Happi+House+Teriyaki?utm_source=openai)


Happi House is a quick-service restaurant chain specializing in teriyaki-style cuisine, established on February 29, 1976, in San Jose's Japantown district. The founders, Joe Ikeda, Carlo Besio, and Richard Tanaka, drew inspiration from traditional Japanese festival foods to create a menu that includes teriyaki, tempura, salads, noodle and rice bowls, sandwiches, and snacks. ([pt.wikipedia.org](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Happi_House?utm_source=openai))

The name "Happi House" is derived from the "happi," a colorful cotton jacket worn during Japanese festivals, reflecting the restaurant's festive and fresh approach to dining. ([pt.wikipedia.org](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Happi_House?utm_source=openai))

Over the years, Happi House expanded through company-owned locations and franchising. However, after an initial franchising attempt, the company refocused on corporate-owned stores to maintain operational control. In 2007, under new leadership, Happi House reintroduced franchising efforts. ([pt.wikipedia.org](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Happi_House?utm_source=openai))

As of 2026, Happi House operates two locations in San Jose, California:

- **695 N. Fifth Street, San Jose, CA 95112**: This is the original Japantown location, known for its fresh, made-to-order meals and homemade teriyaki sauce. ([tripadvisor.com](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Restaurant_Review-g33020-d3888154-Reviews-Happi_House_Famous_Teriyaki-San_Jose_California.html?utm_source=openai))

- **3015 McKee Road, San Jose, CA 95127**: This location offers a similar menu and emphasizes quality service in a family-friendly atmosphere. ([tripadvisor.com](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Restaurant_Review-g33020-d3888153-Reviews-Happi_House_Famous_Teriyaki-San_Jose_California.html?utm_source=openai))

The menu features a variety of dishes, including teriyaki plates, tempura, salads, noodle and rice bowls, sandwiches, and snacks. Popular items include the Chicken Teriyaki Plate, Beef Teriyaki, and Shrimp Tempura. ([menuxp.com](https://www.menuxp.com/happi-house-menu?utm_source=openai))

Happi House has received positive reviews for its flavorful teriyaki chicken and fresh ingredients. Customers appreciate the made-to-order approach, ensuring hot and fresh meals. ([frankiapp.com](https://frankiapp.com/business/happi-house-234784?utm_source=openai))

For more information, including the full menu and operating hours, visit the official Happi House website.

Happi House Famous Teriyaki is a Japanese-American fast-food chain with several locations in the San Jose, California area. The restaurant is known for its teriyaki dishes, tempura sides, and other Japanese-inspired offerings.

Customer reviews for Happi House are mixed. Some patrons appreciate the restaurant for its quick service and nostalgic appeal, noting that it offers a convenient option for Japanese-style fast food. However, other customers have expressed concerns about the authenticity and quality of the food. One reviewer commented that the restaurant serves Japanese-style food that is more akin to American-style Japanese food and found the teriyaki steak and chicken not very palatable. ([reviews.birdeye.com](https://reviews.birdeye.com/happi-house-149316459883469?utm_source=openai))

In terms of ambiance, some locations have been described as clean and well-maintained, while others have received criticism for being run down, with issues like ripped seats and sticky tables. ([wanderlog.com](https://wanderlog.com/place/details/14490270/happi-house-famous-teriyaki?utm_source=openai))

Overall, Happi House offers a quick and convenient dining experience with Japanese-inspired dishes. If you're seeking authentic Japanese cuisine, this may not be the ideal choice. However, if you're looking for a fast-food option with a Japanese twist, it could be worth trying.

The company has been a pioneer in developing and applying self-watering technologies since its inception, reducing the need for weekly watering visits and minimizing environmental impact. By using self-contained, plumbing-free irrigation systems, they have been able to avoid manual, guesswork watering, reducing costs and preventing over-watering. ([kimparkerplants.com](https://www.kimparkerplants.com/water-waste-is-time-waste/?utm_source=openai))

Kim Parker Plants has worked with various clients, including the SAP Center in San Jose, where they have been providing plants, floral, and holiday displays since 1991.
